answer: We formalize a Sybil-resistant protocol where dynamic opportunity-cost bonds, augmented by zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions, enforce a ferrous constraint on identity replication. In this model, any malicious multiplication sends a systemic ripple of automated slashing penalties through a subgame-perfect matrix, driving the adversary’s expected utility below zero. Consequently, as the capital barrier rises like a dune of cumulative staking requirements, the unique Nash equilibrium guarantees honest validation.
